model.name: Task 42.5: Phase 4 — close the auth gaps, CI-made releases
model.description: CREATE_ROOM/JOIN_ROOM use the connection identity; device-key login required; tokens out of the repo and rotated; CI bumps version, stamps sw.js, tags and deploys on merge to main. DONE: CREATE_ROOM/JOIN_ROOM act as the connection's IDENTIFY identity (src/ts/server/connection-identity.ts), a foreign msg.playerToken is refused and no longer re-binds tokenToClient. OPEN: device-key login instead of bare-token IDENTIFY; tokens out of the repo + rotation (needs Tron: touches live users); CI-made release tags (with T42.2).

model.remainingIssues: Done 2026-11-22: CREATE_ROOM/JOIN_ROOM use the connection's identity (PR #6); release tags are made by CI (.github/workflows/release.yml + scripts/tag-on-merge.mjs: tag v<version> only when a push to main bumps the version). Open: device-key login instead of a bare token; test/owner tokens out of the repo and rotated (needs TRON's go). | 2026-11-23 (Tron: "no users automatically log in with a token only" — "with a key only"): an account with keys is entered only with an enrolled device key or by enrolling the device with the secret code (src/ts/server/login-gate.ts). Found while doing it: device-key login had never worked — authorized_keys holds multi-line PEM keys but was matched line by line (fixed in UserKeys.authorizedKeyEntries). Still open: tokens out of the repo + rotation (needs Tron's go), HTTP endpoints that accept ?token=.
